The Fast Forward clue is a task that, once completed, allows teams to skip all remaining tasks and go straight to the Pit Stop. 
In Seasons 1-4, there were Fast Forwards in almost every leg, with each team allowed to only complete 1 for the duration of the 
race. After a 7 leg hiatus, the Fast Forward is back during Season 37!
